headline: FleetX acquires Pando.ai; JSA, CMS INDUSLAW advise
sum: FleetX Technologies Private Limited has acquired Pando.ai, a AI-powered Transportation Management System (TMS) company. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised FleetX on this acquisition.
detail: FleetX Technologies Private Limited has acquired Pando.ai, a AI-powered Transportation Management System (TMS) company. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised FleetX on this acquisition. The transaction was led by Archana Tewary (Partner). Archana Tewary CMS INDUSLAW advised Pando.ai on this transaction.
